Card Q&A.q: Do I have to choose to activate this card's [When Attacking] effect if it triggers?

Card Q&A.a:
No, you can't. If the effect will activate, you must process the "by" condition. If you have a [Royal Base] or [Zaxon] trait card in the trash, you must place 1 of those cards face up as the bottom security card. If you don't have a [Royal Base] or [Zaxon] trait card in the trash, you can choose to place one from the hand face up as the bottom security card.
